namespace.description: The capability interface namespace for this attribute

name.description: The name of the attribute within the namespace

value.description: The attribute value payload, structure depends on the attribute schema

version.description: Version of the capability attribute schema used for this value.

sampledAt.description: Device or provider reported sample time in UTC. Omitted when the source did not report a sample time; fetching the value does not make an unknown or old sample fresh.
